label.purpose: Uppercase micro-headers in the context panel.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hover raise on interactive chrome and the material editor card.

shadows.name: glow-accent
shadows.purpose: Selection and armed state; 1px crisp ring plus soft bloom.

narrative.overview: The HUD is the chassis of a measurement device: matte dark surfaces hold the tools, a single electric-blue accent marks every live or armed state, and the canvas stays the brightest, clearest thing on screen. Chrome recedes; state speaks. Depth is earned by interaction, never decoration at rest.
keyCharacteristics: Flat-until-touched: chrome has no shadows or lifts at rest.
One accent owns selection, armed tools, and live values.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Blue is used for state, never for decoration. If a blue pixel does not tell the user what is selected, armed, or focused, it is in the wrong place.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every live number renders with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Readouts must never wiggle.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Touched Rule
rules.body: A surface at rest carries no shadow. Shadows appear only as a response to hover, press, open, or selection, and never on the canvas.

rules.name: The Canvas Stays Clear Rule
rules.body: No chrome casts onto the stage. The canvas is the brightest, calmest surface; the HUD frames it.

dos: Do keep every surface flat at rest; express state with the two-shadow vocabulary (lift, accent glow) and nothing else.
Do render all live numbers with tabular numerals.
Do theme the browser chrome the design forgets: ::selection, caret, focus-visible rings, and panel scrollbars in the instrument palette.
Do keep icons a single family: drawn SVG, 1.5px stroke, 18px box.
donts: Don't use cream/off-white surfaces, italic accent type, pill buttons, section numbers, or oversized display type.
Don't put shadows, gradients, or accent tints on or over the canvas.
Don't introduce a second saturated hue; danger red is reserved for error text.
Don't let a readout reflow while its value ticks.
Don't create depth with zero-offset colored halos; shadows carry offset and blur.
